notes.title: Mango's Fisharum 1.1
notes.notes: [p][b]Mango's Fisharium Update v1.1[/b] [/p][p]- Keyboard controller now activated only through shortcut ‘U’ or in the Settings[/p][p]- When ‘Keyboard controller’ active, Left click or Right click mouse will deactivate it[/p][p]- Fishing Power Bar reverted (Red to Green)[/p][p]- Added option to turn off Reeling SFX (the one that keep playing when you pull up the fishing rod)[/p][p]- ‘Shiny Fish Caught’ renamed to ‘Unique Shiny Fish Caught’[/p][p]- Rename it too on Steam Achievement[/p][p][/p][p][b]About AI[/b][/p][p]I did used AI to make some texts for the game. [/p][p]On this update, I have replaced all AI generated texts with mine with tiny help from AI to fix my grammar (I’m no english speaker)[/p][p]I will no longer use AI for any creative part (Art, Text, Sound, Images) on my game in the future[/p]
